outro_text: N: This smells so good. Thank you.

intro_text: N: Hi,
outro_text: N: Thanks.

N: Yeah.

N: They found something revolutionary.
P: Really? What is it?
N: I keep asking, but they refuse to tell me.

N: Anyway. Thanks for the meal. I gotta get back to work.

intro_text: N: Just give me my food.

intro_text: N: Evening.
outro_text: P: *He's got an ID badge. Must be someone important.*
P: Working late?
N: Yeah. I'm working as a lab technician on-site.
P: How does it feel to be working on such a big project?
N: You know too?
N: ...Does anyone honor the non-disclosure agreement?
N: Well, it is an amazing discovery.
P: What kind of discovery?
N: The big kind. Like, changing our understanding of the universe big.
N: We dug up something that's still... alive.
P: ... what.
N: I know. I thought they were crazy when they called me in.
N: But, I've been examining samples of it...
N: And it's real. But they won't let me see it in person.
P: *And he says his coworkers are loose-lipped.*
P: They found something that's really alive?
N: Shoot. Look, don't tell anyone I told you that, alright? I gotta go. Thanks for the food.

intro_text: N: There's a lot going on around here.
outro_text: N: You're not safe.

intro_text: N: I haven't eaten at a food truck in years.
outro_text: N: So much nostalgia...

intro_text: N: Good evening! My name is Rody. I work with the local newspaper.
N: I've stumbled on something exciting, and I'd like to ask you a few questions about my discoveries.
N: I've been scouting the area, and..
P: Let me guess, is this about the excavation site?
N: How'd you know?
P: Rody, I'd love to chat, but I don't get paid by the hour. I get paid by the hot dog.
P: You plan to buy something?
N: Uhhh..
N: Anyway- That excavation site had an exciting discovery.
N: But they've been keeping it under wraps. They're acting like it's Area 51.
N: Do you think they found aliens?
N: Have you heard anything from the employees that come by for dinner?
P: I have, actually... One of the lab technicians told me they dug up a living creature.
N: A living creature?! Man, this is about to be the biggest scoop of my life!
N: I'm going to do some looking around the premises. I'll catch up with you tomorrow.
N: Oh, and could I also get a hot dog? Haha.
outro_text: N: Thanks!!
N: You shouldn't be here.

intro_text: N: Food.
outro_text: N: Must be nice to work such a relaxin' job. Meanwhile I'm stuck with this crappy one.
N: Out here riskin' my life for a measly 7.50 an hour.
N: But... I'm start'n to think I wouldn't be safe no matter where I was.
N: Somethin's going wrong around here...
N: ...and I don't want no part of it.

intro_text: N: Could I get a hot dog? I'm famished.
outro_text: N: Yum!

intro_text: N: I.. need a hot dog.
P: Gotcha.
outro_text: N: Ugh.. I think I'm going to throw up.
P: Is the food bad?
N: No.. it's not that... One of my friends didn't show up for his shift today.
N: I was making fun of him to my coworkers for slacking off...
N: They found his mutilated body outside the site. He was attacked last night.
N: His face was unrecognizable. They almost couldn't ID him because his badge was missing.
P: That's horrible.
N: He was dead. I was making fun of him...
N: and he was dead.
N: I'm gonna be sick.
P: *Should I give him the ID badge I found? Someone else might need it.*
N: Who would do this...?

intro_text: N: I'm starving. Give me something good.
outro_text: N: Thanks, I guess.

intro_text: N: I'm lucky I've got the night shift. It's too hot to work out there during the day.
outro_text: N: Thank you for the food.

intro_text: P: It's you again..
outro_text: N: There's no turning back now.

intro_text: N: Hey.
outro_text: P: Find anything for your article?
N: Yes... One of the lab technicians was found dead off-site. I got some photos of his body. It's pretty gruesome.
N: I don't feel good reporting on this. Making his death into some big publicity stunt.
N: But I overheard the forensics talking.
N: And whatever killed him wasn't human.
P: Was it was the creature they dug up?
N: I think so. But it's business as usual at the site.
N: You'd think they'd be on high alert after that, but.. it's almost like they're trying to cover it up.
P: Do you think they are?
N: I do. I need to shift gears.
N: I'm going to expose this whole project. That'll get the government to shut it down.
N: And get the police involved.
N: If I could just get inside.
P: {CHOICE: GIVE ID BADGE}
P: [YES]: This ID badge would get you inside.
N: Woah! Where did you get this? Thanks!
P: [NO]: Good luck with that. Security's pretty tight.
N: Yeah, thanks. I'm going to try my best.
P: Good luck
N: I'll come back tomorrow to give you more updates.
P: Come back alive.
N: I will. I need to.

intro_text: N: Did you see it?
P: See what?
N: That monster they dug up at the excavation site? It's gotten out.
N: I saw it head this way. So, did you see it?
P: I haven't seen anything.
N: Crap...
N: Stay in your van. You'll be safest in here.
P: Can you radio for help?
N: I tried. Radio's down.
P: Not good.
N: I need to get back to my post.
P: Here, I'll get you some food in case you get stuck in there.
outro_text: N: You'll see its eyes first.
